spec.name: daily green injection
spec.query:
import "date"



a =
    from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
        |> range(start: today())
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_energy" and r._field == "outputHomePower")
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with join_key: "x"}))

b =
    from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
        |> range(start: date.add(to: today(), d: -1h))
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_energy" and r._field == "gridInputPower")
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with join_key: "x"}))

join(tables: {a: a, b: b}, on: ["join_key"])
    |> map(
        fn: (r) =>
            ({
                _time: date.add(to: today(), d: 3h),
                _measurement: "daily_energy",
                _field: "green_injected",
                _value: r._value_a - r._value_b,
            }),
    )
    |> to(bucket: "smarthomederived")
